mara:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a polished CHARACTER CONCEPT SHEET for a pixel-art tower defense game, landscape roughly 3:2. This is a preview design proposal, NOT an animation atlas, no game integration.
REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is the existing Wisp builder spritesheet; use it only as the exact visual-language reference: tiny crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, dark plum outlines, restrained 3-tone ramps, robe/cape silhouette, top-down three-quarter fantasy sprite perspective. Do not reproduce the whole sheet.
Main subject: MARA, a clearly adult woman about 28-35, a clever, charismatic magical engineer and companion to Wisp. She is attractive and mildly seductive through a knowing sideways smile, self-assured hand-on-hip posture and a playful wink. Feminine adult silhouette, copper-red side-swept hair with one long braid, pale cream hood folded back, short petrol-teal cape, fitted plum bodice with a tasteful modest V neckline, brass belt with crystal tools, fitted dark trousers and tall leather boots. Small mint crystal-headed spanner. Fully clothed, no nudity. Keep the design readable as an actual small game sprite, not a detailed illustration or anime character.
Layout: restrained dark pine-green flat concept-board background, thin moss-and-brass dividers. Left half: one large nearest-neighbor enlarged full-body main sprite of Mara; very visibly chunky pixels, apparent original resolution around 48x64. Upper right: three consistent smaller sprite views front / side / back at equal scale. Lower right: four expressive pixel face studies, amused / annoyed / determined / surprised; clearly adult. Along bottom left a small side-by-side scale comparison: original white-hooded red-cloaked Wisp silhouette and Mara, same in-game pixel density and footline, Mara only slightly taller. Include a small palette strip of six color squares.
Text, only these short headings: "MARA", "TÜFTLERIN · BEGLEITERIN", "ENTWURF 01". No paragraphs, no speech bubbles.
Hard constraints: clean authentic low-resolution pixel art throughout, visible square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no smooth painterly rendering, no photorealism, no 3D render, no anime, no childlike face or childish styling, no watermark. The existing Wisp is an adult fantasy builder, retain its recognizable red robe and white hood in scale comparison.

boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape pixel-art GAME CAMPAIGN MAP CONCEPT BOARD, 3 columns by 2 rows, six distinct readable tower-defense battlefield dioramas. Primary title "SPIRE · HERZ AUS SPLITTERN", small subtitle "SECHS REGIONEN · EINE REISE". These are design proposals, not a screenshot of an implemented game. Reference images 1 and 2 are existing terrain tiles and tower sprites: match their orthographic top-down / three-quarter 2D pixel look, crisp square pixel clusters, dark outlines, clear readable peach-colored paths, blocky blue-gray stone towers and green fantasy vegetation. New environments must extend this visual language. Do not make cinematic paintings or isometric 3D.
Every panel must show a COMPLETE interesting battlefield: clear visible enemy entrance, connected winding travel routes, open terrain pockets for tower placement, 3-4 small square stone towers, and one glowing mint crystalline Spire goal. Small red entrance arrow and mint goal halo only, no UI overlays. Differentiation must be structural, not palette swaps.
Panel 1 top-left labeled "01 · MOOSHAIN": sunny lush round-canopy forest, orange dirt path forks into two connected alternatives and rejoins before the Spire, manual wooden switch at junction, stream and clearing; green and honey palette.
Panel 2 top-center labeled "02 · LATERNENMOOR": dark teal marsh with islands and plank bridges, a loop of long raised bridges and a partly flooded short crossing, glowing golden lanterns and giant reeds, water level gate; mustard and turquoise palette.
Panel 3 top-right labeled "03 · WINDBRUCH": pale high cliffs with stacked terrain terraces, two rope bridges over deep blue chasms, a looping stone path, wind flags and a distinctive dotted curved aerial flight route; cream rock, sky blue, windblown yellow grass.
Panel 4 bottom-left labeled "04 · GLUTGARTEN": overgrown abandoned foundry in warm russet ruins, orthogonal industrial maze path through pipes and orange ember channels, two large brass steam valves and a visible alternate corridor; vivid burnt orange, charcoal, copper and small green vines. Lava doesn't cross the walkable road.
Panel 5 bottom-center labeled "05 · SPIEGELWINTER": blue-white snowy pine valley, main rocky trail around a frozen lake, a contrasting cracked ice shortcut across lake, angular narrow bends, deep blue shadows and violet crystals.
Panel 6 bottom-right labeled "06 · MONDWARTE": moonlit ruined observatory on interconnected round stone platforms, purple starfield at edges, paired violet and cyan portal arches connected by visible routes to central Spire, multiple approach directions, brass celestial rings; midnight blue, lilac, silver.
Layout: beautiful restrained dark pine-green board with moss-gold hairline dividers and cream legible compact pixel headings, equal panel sizes, wide gutters, no busy ornaments. No other text, no paragraphs. Crisp genuinely pixelated 16-bit game art with consistent pixel density; readable playable-map shapes; no photorealism, no watercolor, no smooth vector, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape concept board showing THREE NEW ADULT FEMALE CHARACTERS for the Spire pixel-art tower-defense campaign. Reference image 1 is the existing Wisp builder; reference image 2 is the approved-for-exploration Mara concept board, STYLE AND PRESENTATION REFERENCE only, do not repeat Mara. The cast should feel like they inhabit the same game. Header exactly "SPIRE · NEUE BEGEGNUNGEN", small tag "FIGURENENTWÜRFE".
Three equal vertical columns, dark pine-green flat background, cream short pixel headings, moss-brass thin dividers. Each column has one large full-body nearest-neighbor-enlarged GAME SPRITE, and below it a small pair of expressive face portraits and tiny in-game-sized sprite. Use authentic visibly chunky hand-placed pixel clusters, dark plum outline, 3-tone ramps, no smooth rendering. Characters are clearly grown adults, age 30-50, stylized fantasy-sprite proportions, not childlike. Give each a distinct face, build, silhouette, personality and outfit.
Left heading "RUNA", subtitle "FÄHRFRAU & SUMPFHEXE": a confident sturdy adult woman about 40, warm brown skin, curly dark hair with a single gray streak, wide floppy moss-colored hat, teal patched coat over practical plum clothes and tall marsh boots, waist satchel; holding a long wooden boat pole and amber ghost-lantern; wry amused expression. Practical, warm and mischievous, strong broad grounded silhouette, yellow/teal palette.
Middle heading "ILYRA", subtitle "HIMMELSRITTERIN": a tall athletic adult woman about 32 with medium brown skin, short white hair swept to one side, ivory and sky-blue armor, feathered half-cape, brass accents, long crystal-tipped lance and aviator goggles on forehead; proud theatrical confident stance, triangular cape silhouette. Dignified, attractive, slightly competitive expression.
Right heading "VESPER", subtitle "ASTRONOMIN": an elegant adult woman about 45 with pale olive skin, long midnight-purple hair with silver streak, fitted high-collared dark violet star robe, one shoulder cape, silver crescent hair ornament, floating brass armillary rings around one hand, luminous small star fragment above other hand. Intelligent, controlled, magnetic presence; sympathetic rival, not evil witch stereotype. Tall narrow silhouette and purple/silver palette.
Every woman has an independent competent role, no harem framing. Faces expressive, attractive adult designs, fully clothed. Match Wisp/Mara fantasy materials and pixel density. Minimal text ONLY specified titles, no dialogue. No photorealism, no 3D, no painterly softness, no anime, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape BESTIARY CONCEPT BOARD, 4 columns x 2 rows, showing EIGHT DISTINCT NEW ENEMY DESIGNS for a charming fantasy tower-defense game. Header exactly "SPIRE · DAS NEUE BESTIARIUM", small tag "GEGNERENTWÜRFE". Input images 1/2 are existing Leafbug and Voidbutterfly sprite atlases and 3 is existing terrain; STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: crisp saturated jewel-like pixels, dark outlines, top-down three-quarter view, readable compact game sprite silhouettes, simple small details, no smooth painted artwork. Match them visually, do not copy/reprint atlas rows.
Dark pine-green flat board, thin moss-gold cell dividers, cream short pixel labels. Each cell shows one large nearest-neighbor enlargement of an original small enemy sprite on a tiny ground shadow; a tiny secondary pose or ability effect beside it. All eight same apparent pixel density; bosses can be bigger. Visual personality and mild comedy, threatening but playful, no gore.
Top row left to right:
"MOOSHÜPFER" - squat green moss-covered frog-insect with oversized spring legs, comically determined face, tiny airborne hopping pose beside it, nimble swarm silhouette.
"SCHILDKÄFER" - broad squat forest beetle with a huge bronze shield-like forward carapace and stubby feet visible behind, its small rear body visibly vulnerable; heavy defensive front, 3/4 view showing front plate and back.
"LATERNENQUALLE" - floating amber marsh jellyfish shaped like a warm hanging lantern with translucent teal tendrils, concentric mint healing-ring pixels reaching a tiny beetle; rounded airborne healer.
"SAMENMUTTER" - walking burgundy flower/pod creature with elegant mushroom-petal crown, seed-pod abdomen and roots as legs, two tiny freshly released sproutlings next to it; distinctive spawner silhouette.
Bottom row left to right:
"WINDROCHEN" - broad sky-blue triangular manta ray with ivory belly, swept wing tips and a long fluttering tail, small wind chevrons; swift aerial shape.
"KESSELKRABBE" - copper pressure boiler with six crab legs, round gauge face and two bent chimney horns, tiny steam puff; comedic industrial tank.
"FROSTWIDDER" - muscular white and icy-blue ram with oversized curling sapphire horns, striking a small patch of cracked ice with one hoof; clear charger silhouette.
"STERNENRICHTER" - hovering tall dark purple armored celestial automaton, oval brass orbit ring around its torso, three floating mint shield fragments protecting a tiny beetle, one stern luminous eye; intimidating late-game support.
No extra text or paragraphs, no damage numbers, no fake screenshot UI. Authentic low-resolution pixel art with readable square clusters and restrained shade ramps, no photorealism, no smooth vector, no anime, no watermark.
